title: POSI AJR-E / AJR-M Rating Snapshot
description: One frozen record per journal per rating_date, produced by posi-engine's src/ajr-early-stage.mjs (track: early_stage) or src/ajr-mature.mjs (track: mature). New schema — no AJR-M rating snapshot shape existed before the 'POSI Journal Evaluation & Ranking Framework 1.0' rollout; AJR-E ratings previously lived only as ad hoc fields on legacy corpus records (see corpus/README.md), not a versioned schema. Never mutated after being written — a correction produces a new snapshot, per the same discipline as schema/metric.schema.json.

track.description: early_stage = AJR-E (AJR-E-1.1-SPEC.md), mature = AJR-M (AJR-M-1.0-SPEC.md). A mature journal must never carry an early_stage rating and vice versa.

methodology_version.description: e.g. AJR-E-1.1 or AJR-M-1.0 — permanent per snapshot, so historical scores are never conflated across a methodology change (see CHANGELOG.md).

rating_status.description: official/provisional/not_rateable come from evidence-coverage.mjs's ratingEligibility() (EC >=80% / 60-79.99% / <60%, mandatory evidence gate). not_officially_rankable is AJR-M-only — a citation-integrity suppression verdict via ajr-mature.mjs's gateAjrMByIntegrity() (never a score deduction — see AJR-M-1.0-SPEC.md § 8).

suppression_reason.description: Set only when rating_status is not_officially_rankable — the specific flagged_checks from the citation-integrity review, per PJR-SPEC.md § 9.

total_score.description: Null when rating_status is not_rateable or not_officially_rankable — never a misleading 0.

dimensions.description: Per-dimension scores, keyed by dimension id. AJR-E: egf/rif/inf/pub/soc/rdc/trn. AJR-M: citation/output/governance/infrastructure/reach/transparency. Shape intentionally loose (additionalProperties true) since the two tracks have different dimension sets and each dimension's own object shape is documented in the corresponding *-SPEC.md, not duplicated here.

quartile.description: Raw Q1-Q4 value from posi-engine's src/quartile-tracks.mjs — pair with `track` to get the correct display label (E-Q1/M-Q1), never displayed bare. Null when ranking_method is unavailable.

quartile_label.description: e.g. 'E-Q1', 'M-Q1' — the full display label per quartile-tracks.mjs's quartileLabel(). Never a bare 'Q1'.

cohort_key.description: The PSC code the peer cohort was built on (may be L1, L2, or L3 — see cohort_level).

pjr_release.description: e.g. PJR-2028.1 — the release this snapshot was frozen for, once published.
